content:
According to Sensor Tower data, downloads of Meta's AI assistant app Muse have surpassed 5 million, continuing to hold the top spot on the U.S. and Canadian App Store charts. Here's what you need to know.

Muse has topped the U.S. App Store for 12 consecutive days

Meta launched Muse in the U.S. three weeks ago. Shortly after, Muse overtook ChatGPT to become the most-downloaded free app on the U.S. App Store.

Kara Lee, Senior Insights Analyst at market intelligence firm Sensor Tower, forecasts that Muse has now crossed the 5 million download mark today. That means Muse reached this milestone far faster than ChatGPT, Grok and Claude — which Sensor Tower noted took 56 days, 103 days and 492 days, respectively, to reach a similar scale.

Muse is Meta's agentic AI assistant that can browse the web and carry out tasks on a user's behalf, including sending emails, shopping, filling out forms, and booking travel arrangements.

Sensor Tower added that Claude and Grok were iOS exclusives during their first five days of launch. By contrast, Meta's Muse app is available on both iOS and Android, though it is currently only available for download in the U.S. and Canada.

Here's some additional context from Sensor Tower on how Muse's path to 5 million downloads compares with the launches of other major apps:

Most Liked Comments by Rom

And more than half of people deleted the app after using it for 5 minutes.

The report added that while Meta's Muse app appears to have generated significant public attention, Meta's own advertising push likely contributed heavily to Muse's rapid uptake.

"Meta began ramping up advertising for Muse on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, with downloads jumping 73% day-over-day on that date," Sensor Tower said, adding:

Sensor Tower also noted that during the week of September 21 to September 27, Muse ranked among the top 15 brands for ad exposure in the U.S.
